Read CONTRIBUTING.md and the documented release scope before proposing new behavior.

## Problem and use case

Describe the concrete problem, affected component and current limitation.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the desired result and the smallest change that would solve the problem.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

Describe existing alternatives and effects on API compatibility, persistence, concurrency, security or resource use, where applicable.

## Validation

Describe observable acceptance criteria. Keep requirements separate from implementation suggestions and estimated results.
